terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Material swatch maps directly to one 8 m UV square; no perspective to solve.

objectClass.primaryType: four-way crossroads planar asphalt road tile
objectClass.notes: Reference is an edge-to-edge material swatch. One quad is an explicit authoring requirement. Mesostructure lives in PBR maps, not separate meshes.

reasoning: One flat square with no independent assemblies; rough aggregate and patch boundaries are surface features.

specDepthDecision.rationale: One macro deck and one material; three surface detail bands and independent PBR channels carry identity.

details.description: Full sheet neutral mid-dark grey low-chroma binder
Broad rectangular repaired patches with subtle tonal differences
Fine branching dark seams in the aggregate
Thin darker repair boundary at image y=.25
Repair edge at image x=.25 extending along tile
All four edges are road ports; join to standard marked roads or a correctly oriented approach.
Chalky neutral pale paint retains aggregate beneath its partial opacity; no metallic or emissive response.
Four .6 m radius quarter circles centred at (0,0),(8,0),(8,8),(0,8), each a .12 m off-white stroke joining adjacent edge-line positions.
The 6.8 m central crossing remains plain asphalt without centre dashes, arrows, stop bands or yellow box markings.
All N/S/W/E road edges have the same two line endpoints at .6/7.4 m and no centre paint at the boundary.
The paint pattern is invariant at all four quarter-turn yaws; source asphalt repairs retain their own orientation.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: One 8 x 8 m plane at y=0 with correct UV orientation and root pivot; no auxiliary geometry.
Preserve the reference asphalt and precisely placed paint: two 0.12 m edge lines 0.6 m in, four 1 m centre dashes on a 2 m cycle.
Independent normal, roughness and subtle AO respond to neutral and grazing lights without boundary seams.
All four resource budgets pass, no map load errors, standard glTF-compatible material, clickable mesh and existing static collision shell.
Whole-asset visual estimate strictly above 95 with evidence for each required pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Existing material-only plane is explicitly authored as two triangles. No Meshy proxy is applicable.
Declared .01 m nominal height is metadata; visible geometry stays exactly at y=0 per asset brief.
The upward face is the complete authored surface; no hidden backside or volume is invented.
The plate supplies no physically calibrated relief or roughness. Saved Patina outputs are inferred PBR evidence and will be tested under relighting.
Crossroads topology has four road ports. Paint is four-way rotationally symmetric; road edges must meet road edges. Stop markings belong on separate approach tiles, and the central box stays bare.

coordinateFrame.note: The quad lies in the ground plane at y=0; the origin is its centre so tiles snap on the kit grid.

The failed archive-relative-map capture is retained separately and is not review evidence.
